dicas.texto: Você está indo muito bem! Pense: quantas vezes o número 5 cabe inteiramente dentro do 12?
Tente subtrair 5 de 12 uma vez, e depois outra vez. Quantas vezes você conseguiu subtrair 5 e quanto sobrou de resto?
Você subtraiu 5 duas vezes, então a parte inteira (m1) é 2. Agora, olhe para o resto que sobrou: esse é o seu novo numerador (m2).
O denominador (m3) continua sendo 5. Se você tirou dois grupos de 5 (que dá 10), quanto falta para chegar em 12? Esse valor vai no campo m2.
Onde o número 2 e 2/5 se localiza entre os números inteiros 2 e 3?
A reta está dividida em 5 partes entre cada número inteiro. Conte duas dessas pequenas marcas após o número 2.
Se cada marca vale 1/5, onde a segunda marca depois do 2 se encontra?
Coloque o ponto exatamente na segunda marcação após o número 2. Você consegue ver as divisões?

interfaceCtat.descricao: Interface FIXA do tutor (a mesma tela para todos os problemas): enunciado; pergunta "What is the fraction in the problem? Convert it to mixed fraction form if it will help you." com duas caixas numéricas (f1 em cima = numerador, f2 embaixo = denominador); botão "Convert" que abre as caixas do número misto (m1 = parte inteira, m2/m3 = fração restante; "-" quando não há); reta numérica de 0 a 3 (numline) onde o aluno marca um ponto, com encaixe em 5 partes por unidade (marcas ocultas); texto de apoio na reta: "The number hint is off in this problem!"; botão Hint; botão Done. Os passos do aluno são ações NESSES componentes (digitar nos campos, converter, marcar o ponto, concluir).

dicas.texto: Think about what the numerator counts in this situation.
Use the total number of gum pieces Brandon gave his friends for the top number.
Look at the sentence that tells how many pieces Brandon gave away altogether.
Type the total number of pieces into the top fraction box.
The denominator tells how many equal pieces are in one whole.
Find the number that describes the size of one gum pack.
Use the number of pieces in each pack, not the total number Brandon gave away.
Type the number of pieces in one pack into the bottom fraction box.
Compare the numerator and denominator to decide whether the fraction represents more than one whole.
A fraction is greater than one when its numerator is larger than its denominator.
Compare 12 with 5 before choosing the button that opens the mixed-number fields.
Since the top number is larger, click Convert to display the mixed-number fields.
A mixed number shows complete groups first and the leftover part second.
Divide the numerator by the denominator to find the whole-number part and the remainder.
Count how many complete groups of five fit into twelve, then identify the pieces left over.
Enter the quotient in m1, the remainder in m2, and keep the original denominator in m3.
Use the mixed-number meaning to locate the fraction between two neighboring whole numbers.
Start at two whole units and move forward by the remaining fraction of one unit.
Each unit is divided into five equal parts, so count two of those parts after 2.
Place the point two-fifths of the way from 2 toward 3.
Review whether the fraction and its location on the number line describe the same amount.
Check the numerator, denominator, mixed-number fields, and marked point before submitting.
Make sure the point lies between 2 and 3 and matches the remaining fraction shown in the mixed number.
When every field and the number-line point are correct, click the Done button.

exercicio.statement:
What if Brandon shared more gum? Let's say each pack had five pieces and he gave his friends a total of 12 pieces. Describe the number of packs of gum Brandon gave away and show the value on the number line.
What is the fraction in the problem? Convert it to mixed fraction form if it will help you.

Enter the number of pieces in one pack as the denominator in the bottom fraction box.

Mark the point on the number line that represents the original fraction.
After checking the fraction and point, select Done to finish the problem.

nodes.description: O aluno inverte a fração, colocando o número menor em cima sempre ou confundindo as variáveis.
nodes.instruction: The numerator represents the pieces Brandon gave away. The number 5 tells how many pieces are in each pack and belongs in the denominator.

nodes.description: O aluno faz a divisão inteira, mas não sabe o que fazer com o resto da divisão.
nodes.instruction: You found two complete packs, but twelve pieces do not divide evenly into groups of five. Include the two pieces left over.

nodes.description: O aluno tenta manipular os números da fração original de forma aditiva ao converter.
nodes.instruction: Do not add the numerator and denominator. Find complete groups of five and use the remainder as the fractional numerator.
